job-default-0-save.run_with:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
D=$(dirname $BASH_SOURCE)
if [ -z "$OUT" ]; then
  OUT=$D/bin${S}
fi
L=()
last_double_dash_index=0
for ((i = $#; i > 1; i--)); do
  if [[ "${!i}" == "--" ]]; then
    last_double_dash_index=$i
    break
  fi
done
if [[ $last_double_dash_index -gt 0 ]]; then
  for ((i = 1; i < last_double_dash_index; i++)); do
    L+=("$1")
    shift
  done
  shift
else
  while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    L+=("$1")
    shift
  done
fi
exec "${L[@]}" \
  -m \
  elf_x86_64 \
  --build-id \
  -e \
  _start \
  --gc-sections \
  -o $OUT \
  $D<case>/start.o \
  $D<case>/ordinary.o \
  $D<case>/eight.o\
  "$@"
# Original output file: img
